notes:
— Origin: indie dev studio (3 engineers + 1 founder) building a VS Code plugin that surfaces code completions and contextual chat from repo docs. Signed up via quickstart and free credits on 2025-02-14.

— Primary ask: hosted API, low friction, minimal infra ops. Wants streaming + function-calling for 'explain code' flow (return structured findings). Also exploring embeddings for repo search.

— Scale/SLAs: small concurrency (1–5 concurrent users early), latency target ~150–300ms for short chat completions, throughput is low. Cost sensitivity high — will monitor per-dev token spend.

— Model prefs: open to smaller/faster variants; asked about automatic fallback when quota/latency issues — prefers transparent routing rules. Mentioned wanting per-request model pinning for experimentation.

— Security: public cloud ok. Wants audit logs for user actions and a simple retention policy setting. No SSO needed yet. Interested in SOC2 status (asked where docs live).

— Quote from founder: "We want to get something in the VS Code marketplace in 6–8 weeks; need reliable streaming and predictable cost for early beta."

— POC plan: use free credits to run 2-week beta with ~50 internal testers; measure latency distribution and token cost per session. If tolerable, move to pay-as-you-go.

— Ask to AE/SE: pricing breakdown for 100k tokens/month, sample config for batching vs latency, guidance on embedding index sizing. SE Maya sent a short example and linked pricing deck.

— CRM notes style: fragmented, action items: "send compact pricing table", "confirm SOC2 link", "follow up after beta (2025-03-05)".
